interpretation: A real staging request passed the server-side provider-backed unlock endpoint and was followed by authorized Premium app requests.

Because the unlock implementation rejects invalid license/email/store/product/variant/activation-policy combinations before issuing a session, this is evidence that one valid Test-mode entitlement satisfied the configured identity checks.
The user-visible Premium library exposed the expected 17 launch-core surfaces after authorization.
This does not by itself close invalid-key, wrong-email, wrong-product, tamper, revalidation, revocation, logout, deactivation, or multi-browser cases.
